Leverage the Gerrit code review (https://gerrit.hyperledger.org/r/#/c/1795/) for implementing the new-channel configuration transaction.
Adopt Node.js and standard SDK development practices for the Node SDK.
Refactor ledger code to align with the updated block structure while removing dependencies on MSP security in tests.

activities.activity_name: UI/UX Design and Documentation for New Visitors
activities.activity_description: Design a user-friendly interface and documentation to help new visitors quickly get started with Hyperledger Fabric.
Implement the API for creating new-channel configuration transactions, including fields and values as described in FAB-687 and the linked Gerrit code.
Develop a mechanism to upgrade peers without data loss, including handling protocol changes and chaincode lifecycle updates.

activities.activity_name: Ledger Code Refactoring and Test Updates
activities.activity_description: Refactor ledger code to use the new block structure and update tests to remove dependencies on MSP security.
Create visual aids and scripts to explain the Hyperledger Fabric v1.0 architecture and behavior for collaborators and customers.

activities.activity_name: Documentation Updates for v0.6 and v1.0
activities.activity_description: Update documentation to direct users to v0.6 for stable operations and provide guidance for v1.0 development.
Implement validation to ensure only LCCC or normal chaincode can be invoked, preventing unauthorized operations.
Develop a Node.js SDK to allow application developers to interact with the Hyperledger Fabric blockchain.
